en-US:
Release candidate for the App Store (0.7.2).
• Audit fixes: amount entry in currencies such as JPY and IDR, scheduled items after a time-zone change, budgets near midnight and DST, loans, split rows in History, and Chinese wording.
• Widgets, Control Center and Siri now open the normal Log after unlock; the separate locked capture form is gone.
• Backups that contain damaged records can be restored, with those records set aside.
• Identical rows on one statement import as separate transactions.
Please check: open every tab, log an entry from a widget, and try a favourite.
zh-Hans:
App Store 候选版本（0.7.2）。
• 审查修复：日元、印尼盾等货币的金额输入，更改时区后的计划收支，午夜与夏令时附近的预算，贷款，明细中的拆分记录，以及中文用语。
• 小组件、控制中心和 Siri 解锁后直接打开常规记账页；不再使用单独的锁定记账表单。
• 含有损坏记录的备份可以恢复，这些记录会单独保留。
• 同一账单中相同的多笔交易会分别导入。
请检查：打开每个标签页，从小组件记一笔，并试用常用记录。
